errorCodes.meaning: The requester holds no live vetter grant in this community.
`label` is not the label this community is currently issuing under.

This member has already enrolled under `label`, and the community will not issue to them again under it — it does not re-issue, or the member has used the re-issues it allows (see Recovering a lost answer). One enrolment per member per label is what makes distinct tags distinct people. The member enrols again at the next label.
`id` is not the identifier this member was bound to at their first enrolment. A member holding two identifiers could be counted twice in one proof.
The blinded request does not verify under the community's published parameters.

schema.description: A vetter asks the community to blind-sign its class credential for a vetting period. What the community signs is a commitment it cannot open, so the credential it issues is one it cannot later recognise — which is what lets the vetter attest without being named.

id.description: The vetter's PCS identifier, multibase base58btc. Recorded once and required again at every later label: a member holding two identifiers could be counted twice in one proof.

label.description: The class label asked for, `vetter/<YYYY-MM>`. A community issues under its current label only; a stale client is refused rather than silently served under another.

request.description: The blinded root request, as the suite serialises it. Opaque to the community beyond verifying it; its members are fixed by the suite named in the criterion's parameters, not by this schema.

encoding.description: The issuance encoding the suite carries.

proof.description: The proof that the commitment is well formed and the requester holds its secret.

t0.description: The request's tag under the root context.
